analyst.summary: FirstCry's revenue continues to grow at a healthy clip and losses are narrowing, but the business is still not profitable on either an equity or capital-employed basis, and management itself has said the ongoing brand-rationalization effort was expected to run through the first quarter of this fiscal year. Competition from larger e-commerce and retail players in the baby-care category is intensifying, and the market has already marked the stock down sharply on margin concerns. We would not hold through this until profitability turns durably positive.
